channel.title: The Argo: the house of 0x8865de06
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Agathkrates #2835 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphod
item.description: Agathkrates #2835 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Agathides #8258 the Twice-Bor
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Agathides #8258 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to Iolcus. Agathides has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Andrdoros #5614 of the Argyreoi fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to me
item.description: Andrdoros #5614 of the Argyreoi fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: The elders of the Reef set the price for broken bone at 60 obols. Melmachos #5798 the Bloo
item.description: The elders of the Reef set the price for broken bone at 60 obols. Melmachos #5798 the Blood-handed paid it; Ikarphon #2019 took it, and spat. Melmachos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
